what_happened: Dispatch claimed relocating --meta/--review/--dream to core requires no dependency untangling beyond events-query.sh, but --dream cites skill-learn/SKILL.md's Overlap Scoring formula and --meta/--dream cite --revise's Classification step (three-strikes threshold) by name; both cited sources stay in the memory extension, which is slated for retirement. Also found a stale quotation in distill-meta-submode.md attributing text to meta-builder-agent.md's 'Known limitation' that no longer exists verbatim in that file. All documented with mitigations in the research report.

Planning surfaced a gate collision the research phase did not: all three relocating sub-mode specs narrate their own draft history ('redefined by overlap resolution, not deletion', 'inherits, in substance unchanged, the current dream section', 'Phase 10 removes the now-duplicated copy', 'pre-redefinition, historical'). A verbatim copy into agent-system/extensions/core/** would be rejected at write time by hooks/validate-no-record-versioning.sh and by the no-task-references hook, because core/** is a deliverable tree where rules/no-record-versioning-in-deliverables.md and rules/no-task-references-in-deliverables.md both apply. The plan therefore cannot specify 'relocate verbatim'; Phase 1 carries an explicit de-narration obligation.

Four dependencies of the three sub-modes were not in the research report's inventory and would break the 'invocable after relocation' verification criterion: (1) the Shared Sub-Mode Skeleton all three cite lives in memory's skill-distill/SKILL.md and has no core counterpart; (2) --meta logs to .memory/meta-log.json and --dream to .memory/dream-log.json, both memory-extension data paths; (3) --dream's existing-coverage check reads .memory/memory-index.json; (4) skill-distill's allowed-tools frontmatter omits the Agent tool that --meta's documented meta-builder-agent delegation requires. All four are resolved explicitly in the plan.

suite_selection_select from scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh resolved every planned touched path to its covering suites in a single scripted pass, letting all five Tier Justification lines be measured rather than asserted; it also revealed the clean split between __FULL_SWEEP__ guidance markdown and the manifest/index/skill/README classes that drive the two non-final full declarations.

Phase 1's planned task to replace distill-meta-submode.md's stale meta-builder-agent.md 'Known limitation' quotation was already satisfied: commit 2730547c3 (same planning-cycle session sess_1794228960_78281f) had already rewritten that paragraph to fresh SCOPE-BOUNDARY-grounded prose before this implement dispatch read the source file. Relocation simply carried the already-fixed text forward; no additional rewrite was required.
